record.one_liner: Collaborative docs and tables platform (formerly Coda, now Superhuman Docs) with a REST API and an MCP server
record.auth_notes: critic: confirmed. Public API uses a personal API token sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. OAuth is documented only for connecting to the Docs MCP server, not for the public REST API.
record.access_notes: critic: confirmed self_serve_free. The API is free for all users in free and paid workspaces; token usage is limited by the token owner's workspace role.
record.api_notes: REST endpoints under coda.io/apis/v1 for folders, docs and other objects, with read and write methods shown in the official reference.

evidence.quote: We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.
Under the hood, Superhuman Docs runs an MCP server built on the open Model Context Protocol standard
